ogDescription: Combine, split, rotate and create PDFs locally - no upload and no signup.
ldDescription: Merge PDFs, extract page ranges, rotate pages and create a PDF from images locally in the browser.
lede: Combine several PDFs, keep only the pages you need, rotate a document or build a PDF from images. Every step happens on your device.

faq.a: Add two or more PDFs, put them in the order you want with the arrows, then press Merge. The download contains every page in that order.

faq.q: How do I write page ranges?
faq.a: Use numbers and ranges separated by commas, like 1-3,5. Pages are counted from 1. For split mode, each range creates one page in the new file.
